title: Life Orchestrator setup config
description: Machine-portable repo-root + data-root + machine profile. Resolved by Resolve-LifeorchConfig (ops/setup/LifeorchConfig.psm1). Generated per machine by setup.ps1 -Action detect -WriteConfig; roots are DETECTED at runtime, never hard-coded in code. Validated by the schema subset Test-JsonAgainstSchema supports: type / required / properties / items / enum / minimum.

python_interpreters.description: OPTIONAL per-machine map of python interpreter paths by role (additive, i17 FANOUT_AGENT_002). 'system' = the CPU system python used by image.util #15 (Pillow/numpy/cv2) + detect.objects #16 (onnxruntime). Resolved by Resolve-LifeorchInterpreter (ops/setup/LifeorchConfig.psm1) with a FALLBACK to each module's hard-coded literal when this section/role is absent, so on-box behavior is byte-identical and nothing breaks if it is missing. NOT required; NOT auto-generated by setup detect yet (a named follow-on); a detect that regenerates config carries an existing map forward. Model-bound venvs (speech #12/#23/#24/#25) are out of scope by role.
